comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.
Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Wagner (knee) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Bucks, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.
Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.
Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.
Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.
Robinson (quadriceps) is considered day-to-day as he progresses in his rehab, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.
Duren (hamstring) is being assigned to the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday for practice as he ramps up for a return, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Curry (abdomen) will be re-evaluated Friday after Thanksgiving, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Nance exited Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle and he will not return, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
McConnell (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Haliburton (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Reaves (heel) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.
Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.
Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Edey (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 115-97 win over the Clippers. He finished with seven points (3-4 FG, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, two assists and two blocks across nine minutes.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.
Ball (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 113-106 win over the Thunder.
Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.
Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
Drummond (head) did not return to Wednesday's 121-102 win over the Cavaliers.
Clarkson (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
McBride (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.
Anunoby (calf) participated in on-court work for the first time since sustaining the injury, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.
Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.
Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.
Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.
Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.

Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.
Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.
Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Brown (hamstring) will receive imaging, and the Sixers will provide an update Thursday, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.
Fox (shin) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.
Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.
Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.
